svg.text: 03. Timeline: st_video_transmitter.c Across Link Drop & Link Up (Before vs. After PR #1951)
Non-linear horizontal time axis: "//" marks a cut. Source: lib/src/st2110/st_video_transmitter.c & st_tx_link.h (15e2f411 vs. c5f235c3).
BEFORE (15e2f411) — Blind Bursting, 1 s Hang False Positive & Direct-Chain UAF Hazard
ALT: if link returns early (< 1 s)
TSC, RL pads & TSN keep pumping
no drain wait, no pkt 0 gate
only last pkt N-1 holds refcnt
early pkts hold NO ref on sh_info
while pkts 0..N-2 still sit in NIC ring
Before failure modes: (1) Transient link drop fills the NIC ring and trips the 1 s hang threshold into fatal recovery; (2) early link return flushes stale
packets late (breaching ST 2110-21 VRX/CINST); (3) dropping a direct-chain frame's last packet frees frame memory while earlier packets remain in the NIC ring.
AFTER (c5f235c3) — video_trs_link_down(), Direct-Chain Pin/Unpin Fence & RL/TSN Resume Guard
frees at pacing time; hang paused
drops pkts while stale ring drains
RL checks before pkt 0 warm-up pads
safe when pkt N-1 is dropped
UP -> DOWN (150 ms): st_tx_link_changed() resets last_burst_succ_time_tsc, pins trs_frame_started BEFORE dropping, sets tx_link_resync.
DOWN -> UP (350 ms): trs_link_resume_tsc = link->tsc + nb_tx_desc * trs + warm_ns (RL adds warm_pkts * trs + refill_ns; TSN waits past trs_wire_tsc).
Unpin fence (358 ms): After nb_tx_desc pkts accepted post-UP, video_trs_link_unpin() clears sh_pins across sh_info[0..3] and invokes free_cb.
